fusions.name: Stinger
fusions.desc: Drives a barbed sting into the first enemy it meets at a cost of 5% of your maximum health. It deals 9 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Massed Swarm
fusions.desc: Looses 4 stinging shots at once, spread apart. Each deals 5 damage and knocks its target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Hive Roused
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds. A swarm fights beside you for 10 seconds, stinging for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Many Small Loads
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you deal 3% more damage per stack, 24% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
